purpose: A05 real-corpus selection and A06 read-only baseline trace: the minimum read-only command set needed to complete phase A. Nothing here writes, downloads or changes worker/task state.
status: NOT APPROVED - awaiting owner confirmation (gate G4 for behaviour beyond --help; gate G7 for the sample list)
requested_by: author session (2026-09-11, under the owner's 'keep going' instruction)
why_it_currently_differs_from_the_execut: The approved manifest of 2026-09-11 covered `--help` only. These commands open the production catalog read-only, so they need their own explicit approval rather than being folded into that one.

commands.purpose: catalog counts only (documents/sources/artifacts); no document content
list a bounded page of indexed documents to pick candidates across roots
find exact-copy groups (same content_sha256) to satisfy the 'two copies of one version' sample requirement
per-sample locator/period evidence for the oracle (metadata only, no span bodies)
confirm which samples have sections vs missing text (L10 sample selection)
record catalog size/disk health as the baseline context for the A06 trace
record the runtime policy snapshot the reader uses (fails closed when absent)

explicitly_excluded: scan / normalize / summarize / run / worker* (writes catalog or starts background work)
install-startup / uninstall-startup / activation apply|rollback / runtime-policy apply (system state)
any --dry-run of the write commands (belongs to a separate behavioural manifest)
side_effect_expectation: read-only opens of the catalog; catalog.sqlite3 and -wal must stay unchanged; -shm may advance on open (documented in ../2026-09-11_r4-phase-a/boundary-audit.md)
post_snapshot: same as pre_snapshot, recorded in the same evidence file as the run
stop_rules: any write to the catalog or -wal -> stop immediately and record
network egress observed -> stop (none of these commands needs network)
a command returns non-zero -> stop and record; do not retry with different flags
output larger than the bounded limit -> stop and re-scope rather than scanning the whole catalog
isolation_note: A05/A06 read the production catalog read-only for metadata only. Behavioural probes (L01-L12 mechanism runs) must NOT use the production catalog: they require the isolated copy in gate G8.

approval.scope_requested: read-only metadata commands A05-1..A05-5 and A06-1..A06-2, bounded as above
